### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. neuropathy, hereditary sensory, type 1D  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.782)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:11231)

**Proposed mechanism:** ATL1 (HGNC:11231) —DISRUPTS→ Neuronal development and maintenance (GO:0050767); Neuronal development and maintenance (GO:0050767) —LEADS_TO→ Spasticity (HP:0001257); Neuronal development and maintenance (GO:0050767) —LEADS_TO→ Sensory neuropathy (HP:0003496). Mutations in ATL1 disrupt critical pathways for neuronal development and maintenance, leading to the distinct but overlapping phenotypes of spasticity (HSP3A) and sensory neuropathy (HSN1D).

**How to falsify it:** Identification of distinct, non-overlapping functional consequences of ATL1 mutations in neurons that specifically explain spasticity versus sensory neuropathy, or the discovery of a different causal gene for one of the diseases. _(variant: The presence of common loss-of-function variants in ATL1 in the general population (gnomAD > 1%) would challenge the haploinsufficiency model.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of ATL1 in these neurological disorders could lead to the development of therapies that target common pathways involved in neuronal maintenance and function, potentially benefiting patients with both hereditary spastic paraplegia and hereditary sensory neuropathies.
